GitHub - Zylann/godot_voxel: Voxel module for Godot Engine
Minecraft-style blocky voxel terrain, with multiple materials and baked ambient occlusion Smooth terrain with level of detail using Transvoxel Voxel storage using 8-bit or 16-bit channels for any general purpose Instancing system to spawn foliage, rocks and other decoration on surfaces Check the changelog for more recent details.
